about.credits_sub: Arcivo stands on the shoulders of these projects.
about.license_line: Arcivo is released under the MIT License. © Bitologist.
about.privacy_text: Everything stays on your computer. Arcivo has no servers, no telemetry and no analytics. Your messages are never uploaded anywhere else or used to train any model.
about.unofficial_text: Arcivo is an independent, open-source project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Telegram. It uses the Telegram API with credentials that you create yourself, and it must be used in accordance with the Telegram API Terms of Service. Telegram is a trademark of its respective owner.
about.what_text: Arcivo is a desktop workspace for your Telegram Saved Messages: it indexes them locally so you can search, filter, analyse storage, find duplicates, organise with tags and smart collections, and export to open formats — with safe, reviewed bulk deletion when you want to tidy up.

account.api_notice: Arcivo is an independent client that talks to Telegram through the official Telegram API using your own api_id and api_hash. Your session is stored in the operating system's credential vault and never leaves this computer.

settings.cache_safe: Your index, tags and session were not touched.

settings.max_flood_wait: Wait automatically for rate limits up to
settings.privacy_facts_text:
• An index of message metadata and text in a local SQLite database.
• Thumbnails in a size-limited cache.
• Your session and API keys in the OS credential vault (Windows Credential Manager).
• No telemetry, analytics or third-party servers. Arcivo only talks to Telegram.
settings.proxy_link_invalid: That doesn't look like a tg://proxy, t.me/proxy or socks5:// link.
settings.proxy_note: Changes apply to the next connection. Restart Arcivo after changing the proxy. The same setting is used by the console app (Arcivo.exe → Proxy settings).
settings.reset_all_text: Restore every setting to its default? Your data and session are kept.
settings.reset_index_text: Type RESET to remove all indexed messages from this computer:
settings.restart_hint: Restart Arcivo to apply this change.

storage.check_first: Tick the files you want first

sync.idle: Idle — your archive is up to date as of the last sync.
sync.mode_full_text: Walk the whole history again to detect edits and deletions everywhere. Slower; respects rate limits.
sync.mode_incremental_text: Fetch new messages and re-check the most recent ones for edits and deletions. Fast; use it daily.
sync.mode_initial_text: Index the full history. Interrupted runs resume from the last checkpoint.
sync.modes_sub: Choose how thoroughly to compare with Telegram.
sync.rate_note: Arcivo requests history in small pages with a polite delay and always honours Telegram's FLOOD_WAIT. It never tries to bypass rate limits.
sync.subtitle: Keep the local index in step with Telegram, gently and resumably.

tags.tips_text: Select messages and press Ctrl+T to tag them, or drag them onto a tag in the Explorer filter panel. Use tag:Name in searches and smart collections. Tags never leave your computer.

welcome.control_text: Nothing is ever deleted without a clear preview and your confirmation. Exports use open formats.
welcome.direct_text: It connects straight to Telegram with your own API key, the same way the official apps do.
welcome.fineprint: Arcivo is free, open source and not affiliated with Telegram.
welcome.local_text: Arcivo builds a private index of your Saved Messages on your own disk. Nothing is uploaded to any server.
welcome.local_title: Your data stays on this computer
welcome.private_text: No accounts, no tracking, no analytics. Arcivo never sees your messages – only you do.
welcome.subtitle: A calm, fast home for everything you've saved in Telegram.
